name: mem0
description: Persistent Mem0 memory for Codex through the hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Persist and retrieve project memory in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Mem0's hosted MCP server for searchable project memory. The API key stays in the local environment and is never stored in this repository.
defaultPrompt: Save durable project decisions and retrieve relevant memory when needed.
